name: Chana Masala
steps: Heat the oil and sauté the chopped onion until golden.
Add the garlic, then the blended tomato and spices, cooking until the oil separates.
Stir in the cooked chickpeas with a splash of water.
Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken further and finish with fresh coriander.
